text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I've posted that answer to Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message.

Tobias raised #88412 in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. He described it as the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. In the same thread he confirmed the ticket was for Tansleigh Packaging (account code TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something they can see themselves.
